Thames Hare & Hounds were first Surrey team followed by Ranelagh and South London while Borough of Hounslow, first across the finish line, were helped no end by Sam Haughian running day's fastest time on lap 1 and then second fastest when he turned out again for lap 4. Our own Paul Coughlan's 14:43 was 5th best.

Everyone seems to want to run on the first leg and this time Paul Coughlan got the nod. South London clearly led the field home thanks to Stuart Major's opening 13:15 while Paul's 7th place among a knot of other runners gave Kevin Quinn plenty of opposition to get stuck into.
Our 'Kiwi' Coughlan and Klepacz of Portsmouth had both fallen on the last lap but as the funnel was approached it was the Belgravian who prevailed.

Paul Coughlan's dad Peter, over here to run London, volunteered to fill in for the Bs and keep that team alive. Stage 10: Young Kevin Quinn was in at the deep end and no mistake, one of our reserves but taking over in the lead.
